model_provenance: Duncan Munro 12AX7s V1 1997, educational generic model with grid current; unchanged repository model. Not an exact purchased tube.
scope: Preamp only, original input; ideal fixed supplies and ideal relay selection, no power stage or reverb.

assumptions.source: 20k resistive Thevenin plus470pF cable; not a specific humbucker model
assumptions.supplies: B_EARLY240/278/320V, B_PRE35V higher; sensitivity envelope around historical nominal278V, not supply qualification
assumptions.controls: tone/gain0.5 electrical fraction; clean volume/dirty master0.25. These are not knob rotation percentages.
assumptions.output_load: 1M resistive test load, not complete FX/reverb/PI impedance

screening_criteria: Record first-stage5%THD and1dB compression crossings; diagnostic thresholds, not an agreed clean product spec.
